elysia biro.bio: Vancouver Island-raised Canadian singer-songwriter and pianist Elysia Biro blends classical technique, jazz improvisation and contemporary pop songwriting in a polished, piano-led sound.

fame holiday.bio: Mississauga-based rapper Fame Holiday is a Canadian hip-hop artist known for melodic hooks, independent releases and storytelling rooted in life outside Toronto's downtown core.

famous.bio: Montréal-born rapper and broadcaster Famous, born Ashton Bishop, is a Canadian hip-hop artist whose debut EP I Rap Now earned a Juno Award nomination before he expanded his career internationally.

fionn.bio: Vancouver-area twin sisters Alanna and Brianne Finn-Morris perform as Fionn, a Canadian indie-pop duo whose harmony-rich songwriting has evolved from folk-pop toward alternative rock.

fito blanko.bio: Panamanian-Canadian singer, songwriter and producer Fito Blanko is a Mississauga-rooted tropical urban artist whose music combines reggaeton, dancehall and North American pop and hip-hop influences.

gangis khan.bio: Scarborough rapper Gangis Khan, also known as Camoflauge, is a Canadian hip-hop artist whose independent career grew out of Toronto's street-rap scene and collaborations across the city's rap community.

genevieve fisher.bio: London, Ontario singer-songwriter Genevieve Fisher is a Canadian country artist with multiple national radio hits and repeated Country Music Association of Ontario award nominations.

gurinder gill.bio: Indian-born Canadian rapper and singer Gurinder Gill is a Victoria-rooted Punjabi artist whose global catalogue blends Punjabi vocals with hip-hop, R&B, pop rap and trap.

haley smalls.bio: Toronto singer-songwriter and recording engineer Haley Smalls is a Canadian R&B artist whose independent catalogue pairs classically trained vocals with contemporary, melody-driven production.

harvey stripes.bio: Ottawa-raised, Toronto-based rapper Harvey Stripes is a Canadian hip-hop artist whose independent career has included national touring and collaborations with artists from both Canadian and U.S. rap scenes.
